name: Nanase Shiyou
source:
Star Sign: Aquarius
Amethyst of the 'Jewel Five'.
3rd year high school student, Onmyoudou course.

A purple onmyouji with a lingering quiet gaze.
He grew up in an onmyouji family, a stoic guy who has an otherworldly feeling about him. Very 'my pace'.
He has a calm atmosphere around him that doesn't make you think of a high schooler and he doesn't show his feelings much.
Part of the archery club, he speaks in Kyoto-ben.
